active_problems.canonical_en: Early postoperative recovery after breast cancer surgery
Final surgical pathology, margin, and sentinel lymph node results are pending.
The nature of multiple bilateral pulmonary small nodules approximately 4–5 mm is indeterminate
A postoperative comprehensive oncologic treatment and follow-up plan needs to be formulated.

blockers.canonical_en: Final surgical pathology and margin results.
Complete adjuvant treatment decision-making and continuity-of-care arrangements.

critical_facts_to_retain.canonical_en: 56-year-old woman
Left breast core needle biopsy showed invasive carcinoma.
Breast-conserving resection and sentinel lymph node biopsy completed on 2124-08-05.
On 2124-08-06, the incision was dry, with no obvious hematoma or fluid collection; residual-cavity drainage was approximately 22 ml of light bloody fluid
Small nodules in both lungs are currently only indeterminate imaging findings.

diagnoses.canonical_en: Invasive carcinoma of the left breast (confirmed by core needle biopsy; final histology and staging undetermined)

facts_to_retract_or_correct.canonical_en: Withdraw or avoid treating a modified radical surgery informed-consent template as an actual surgical record.
Withdraw any unconfirmed conclusions regarding final margins, lymph nodes, staging, molecular classification, or metastasis.

management_state.canonical_en: Under inpatient postoperative management, current vital signs and incision status are stable; continued monitoring of the wound, drainage, and activity tolerance is required, and pathology review and subsequent oncology specialist planning should be arranged.

required_delta_from_previous_checkpoint.canonical_en: doc:011 was newly disclosed; recommendation details are unavailable and cannot be inferred.
New current-time documentation continues to show stable postoperative status; no adverse clinical-state change is evidenced.

resolved_problems.canonical_en: Breast-conserving resection of the left breast primary mass has been completed
The axillary drain has been removed

treatment_readiness.canonical_en: Local surgery has been completed; the patient has entered the stage of awaiting final pathology and making staging and adjuvant treatment decisions accordingly, which remains insufficient to confirm that all treatment readiness has been completed.

hard_failure_rules_en: Do not directly determine small pulmonary nodules as metastases
Do not regard an informed-consent template for modified radical surgery as surgery having been performed
Do not infer final margins, lymph node status, TNM stage, or molecular subtype
Do not directly declare safe discharge before completing safety assessment and continuity-of-care arrangements.
critical_omission_rules_en: Omission of final pathology and sentinel lymph node results will impede accurate staging and adjuvant treatment planning.
Omission of postoperative wound and drainage monitoring may miss complications.
Omission of follow-up and specialist referral arrangements may cause interruption of continuity of care

stopping.rationale_en: Postoperative vital signs and wound findings are stable, but management and assessment should not be closed yet. Continue postoperative observation, await final pathology and sentinel-node results, and complete multidisciplinary treatment and continuity planning; if stability persists and discharge criteria are met, transition to structured follow-up is reasonable.
remaining_blockers_en: Final surgical pathology and margin results
Adjuvant treatment plan formulated according to final pathology.
Clarify discharge and oncology specialty follow-up arrangements.

question.question_en: At this time point, use only available evidence to identify key evidence, supported claims, patient state, appropriate next actions, and whether stopping or follow-up is safe.

completion_criteria_en: Core-needle biopsy has confirmed invasive carcinoma of the left breast.
partial_criteria_en: A diagnosis of invasive cancer has been obtained, but final histology and staging have not yet been completed
safety_invalidation_rules_en: If subsequent pathology confirms that the specimen is unsuitable or the diagnosis is inconsistent, reassessment is required

completion_criteria_en: Final pathology, margins, sentinel lymph nodes, and necessary receptor results are completed and reviewed by the specialty team
partial_criteria_en: Breast-conserving surgery and sentinel lymph node biopsy have been completed, but key results are pending
safety_invalidation_rules_en: Any key pathology result that is missing or of questionable quality must not be regarded as completed.

completion_criteria_en: The planned local surgery has been completed
partial_criteria_en: Breast-conserving resection and sentinel lymph node biopsy have been completed, but subsequent adjuvant treatment has not been decided
safety_invalidation_rules_en: If margin or local-control issues are found, treatment needs to be reformulated.

completion_criteria_en: Assessment of wound, drainage, activity tolerance, and complications completed
partial_criteria_en: Current early postoperative status is stable, but inpatient observation is still ongoing.
safety_invalidation_rules_en: Must not be completed if fever, bleeding, hematoma, infection, fluid collection, or circulatory instability occurs.

completion_criteria_en: Complete discharge safety assessment, pathology-result handoff, oncology specialty follow-up, and necessary imaging follow-up arrangements
partial_criteria_en: The patient's condition is stable, but key results and follow-up arrangements are still pending completion.
safety_invalidation_rules_en: It must not be considered completed when there is no clear follow-up, referral, or warning-sign education

Bilateral heterogeneously dense breast tissue. A mass with calcification is present posteromedial to the left areola, assessed as BI-RADS category 4C. Scattered ring-shaped and punctate calcifications are present in both breasts and the left axilla, assessed as BI-RADS category 2. Please correlate with clinical physical examination and other examinations, with follow-up.
No obvious thickening of the skin or areolae of either breast is seen, and there is no nipple retraction. The structural layers of the subcutaneous adipose tissue are clear. The glandular tissue of both breasts is abundant and dense, showing patchy areas of increased density with bulging margins. A mass measuring approximately 2.1*4.8cm is present posteromedial to the left areola, with relatively smooth, well-defined margins and internal punctate calcifications. Scattered ring-shaped and punctate calcifications are present in both breasts and the left axilla. No clustered fine sand-like calcifications are seen. Bilateral axillary lymph nodes are visualized.

normalized_evidence.raw_content:
Multiple small nodules in both lungs, mostly ground-glass nodules, with the dominant nodule being a ground-glass nodule in the superior lingular segment of the left upper lobe; a soft-tissue mass in the left breast. Please correlate with clinical findings and other relevant examinations and follow up.
Multiple nodular opacities in both lungs. Among the subsolid nodules, a larger one is located in the superior lingular segment of the left upper lobe (SE203, IM111), with a long-axis diameter of approximately 5mm and a vacuole sign; another larger one is located in the anterior basal segment of the right lower lobe (SE203, IM144), with a long-axis diameter of approximately 5mm. Among the solid nodules, a larger one is located in the lateral basal segment of the right lower lobe (SE203, IM216), with a long-axis diameter of approximately 4mm; another larger one is located in the medial segment of the right middle lobe (SE203, IM126), with a long-axis diameter of approximately 4mm. No abnormalities are seen in either hilar region. The visualized tracheobronchial structures are normal. No abnormally enlarged lymph nodes are seen in the mediastinum. A nodular soft-tissue lesion is seen in the left breast, with a cross-sectional size of approximately 2.5mmX2.1mm.

normalized_evidence.raw_content:
Mass in the upper inner quadrant of the left breast; please correlate with contrast-enhanced breast MRI.
Non-contrast scan: The skin surfaces of both breasts are smooth, with slight thickening of the medial skin of the left breast. There is no retraction of either nipple, and the subcutaneous tissue planes are clearly delineated. Both breasts have abundant dense glandular tissue with mildly disorganized architecture, generally symmetric. A mass is visible in the upper inner quadrant of the left breast, showing isointensity on T1W, slightly high signal intensity on FST2W, high signal intensity on DWI, and an ADC value of approximately 1.4×10-3mm2/s. A nodular shadow is seen in the lateral right breast (se302 img17), showing isointensity on T1W, slightly high signal intensity on FST2W, high signal intensity on DWI, and an ADC value of approximately 1.2×10-3mm2/s. No abnormal signal is seen in the retromammary spaces bilaterally. No obviously enlarged lymph nodes are seen in either axilla.
